title: Doors v3 — the door in your pocket

sections.text: Everyone told you college is the only way. They never showed you these.
E-commerce. Freelancing. Reselling. Content creation. That clothing brand you wanted to start. And about a hundred more.
People call these ridiculous, right up until somebody actually pulls it off.
Nobody's asking for your GPA. You don't even have to know what you want yet.
Right now, people your age are building audiences from their bedroom, with a phone and Wi-Fi.
College isn't bad. It's just not the only door. And the one in your pocket? It's already open. So why are you still standing in the hallway?
